mapper.select:
select sr.reservation_id, sr.reservation_no, sr.reservation_type, sr.applicant_id, sr.applicant_name, sr.applicant_role, null as applicant_phone, null as org_id, null as org_name, sr.title, sr.purpose, sr.people_count, sr.detail_remark, sr.status, sr.audit_type, sr.submit_time, null as auditor_id, null as auditor_name, sr.audit_time, null as reject_reason, sr.version, null as del_flag, null as create_by, sr.create_time, null as update_by, sr.update_time, null as remark, summary.room_id, summary.room_code, summary.room_name, case when summary.min_booking_date = summary.max_booking_date then summary.min_booking_date else concat(summary.min_booking_date, ' 至 ', summary.max_booking_date) end as date_range_text, case when summary.time_range_count = 1 then summary.min_time_range else '多时段' end as time_range_text, summary.approved_item_count from space_reservation sr inner join ( select sri.reservation_id, min(sri.room_id) as room_id, case when count(distinct sri.room_id) = 1 then min(sri.room_code) else '多房间' end as room_code, case when count(distinct sri.room_id) = 1 then min(sri.room_name) else '多房间' end as room_name, min(sri.booking_date) as min_booking_date, max(sri.booking_date) as max_booking_date, min(concat(left(sri.start_time, 5), ' - ', left(sri.end_time, 5))) as min_time_range, count(distinct concat(left(sri.start_time, 5), ' - ', left(sri.end_time, 5))) as time_range_count, count(1) as approved_item_count from space_reservation_item sri where sri.item_status = '2' and sri.room_id = #{roomId} and sri.booking_date >= #{bookingDateStart} and sri.booking_date <= #{bookingDateEnd} group by sri.reservation_id ) summary on summary.reservation_id = sr.reservation_id
and sr.del_flag = '0' and sr.status in ('2', '3', '6') and sr.reservation_id = #{reservationId} and sr.reservation_no like concat('%', #{reservationNo}, '%') and sr.reservation_type = #{reservationType} and sr.applicant_name like concat('%', #{applicantName}, '%') and sr.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
order by summary.max_booking_date desc, sr.reservation_id desc
